388YE Winter Solstice interlude.d: The Quartermaster General limited the 350-throne Imperial Guerdon to units supporting the Golden Axe in the Salt Flats of Sanath, the Seventh Wave in Mareave, and the search for the Drakes lost in Crucible. Military units were offered ventures to ward Kroll, aid the Commonwealth and Jarm against Cold Sun, support the Suranni Black Eagle Banner in Reinos, scout or sabotage the scouting of Tsirku, and fight in Spiral. Navarri could treasonously join Agramant's heralds in Therunin. Jakhalsmarkt closed to Imperial fleets after its 70-throne investment went unpaid. The Calvos docks were completed, and enchantments and curses touched Segura, Ossium, Weirwater, Semmerholm, Upwold, Casinea, Spiral and Mareave.

n.Dawn: Dawnish units could protect the vales of Varushka, gained bonuses fighting for Jarm and an extra two ingots of green iron with the Black Eagle Banner, and could fight in Spiral. At home Weirwater was enchanted with Night magic and Semmerholm was cursed.
n.Druj: Navarri allied with Agramant's heralds sought to retake the nominally Druj-controlled regions of Therunin, while Imperial units earned Guerdon shares supporting the Golden Axe in the Druj-held Salt Flats of Sanath.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but it shares Mareave, where the Seventh Wave fought and where Rivers of Life and other rituals were cast.
n.Highguard: Highborn units received a one-rank bonus for aiding the Commonwealth against Cold Sun. Pilgrims were urged to travel to Bastion to help build the Grand Inspiration, and Casinea was enchanted with a song spreading across the trods.
n.Imperial Orcs: Imperial Orc-held Mareave was blessed with Rivers of Life and protected by Frozen Citadel rituals in three regions and Ramparts of Ashlar at Rucraic's Redoubt. Units supporting the Seventh Wave there shared the Guerdon.
n.Jotun: Imperial units were invited to support the Suranni Black Eagle Banner in a wider effort to conquer Jotun-held Reinos. The Tsirku scouts also sought details of any significant Jotun presence in the wastes.
n.Navarr: Navarri could join Dochas Weeping Glade and Agramant's heralds to reconquer Therunin, an act of treason, and Navarr units faced no penalty searching for the Drakes. Navarr forests in Ossium also suffered the Dubik's bloody harvest.
n.The Brass Coast: The completed Municipal Docks of Calvos gave every Freeborn seven extra rings a season, cheaper fleet upgrades and stronger fleets in Madruga. Freeborn fleets could hunt the Free Landing kraken, and Segura was enchanted towards becoming the City of Wonders.
n.The League: League units were sought by both the Commonwealth and Jarm and could fight in Spiral, which was also enchanted with Hand of the Dhomiro. Temeschwari congregations could preach Pride for their city, and Leaguers could convert resources to businesses for free.
n.The Marches: Marchers rallied to rescue the Drakes lost in Crucible. Mournwold suffered disruption from the Rebellion's Ridge consecration, Upwold's forges were enchanted to speed a new army, and Marchers could convert resources to farms for free.
n.Thule: A Thule coven performed a Summer ritual on Ossium at the Lord of the Aurorae's offer to improve the Jaws of Winter Lightning. The Imperial scouts of Tsirku sought details of any significant Thule presence and links to Otkodov.
n.Urizen: Urizen could send units to secure Kroll's lair so the creature could be warded with ilium and later called to defend the region. Urizen units were also favoured by Jarm and fought in Spiral, and the Walls of Cargo in Limus were strengthened.
n.Varushka: Varushkans protecting the vales received potions of the deep wood, while Ossium's forests were plagued by the Dubik and the territory was enchanted with Summer magic. Varushkan units escaped the cold penalty in Tsirku.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark units faced no cold penalty scouting Tsirku, where the Mediator of Hyljehal had secured the hylje's aid. Hahnmark herbalists could cultivate Draaikolkbloem, and West Marsh in Kallavesa was enchanted by the Sussivari Frost Coven.

t.Bastion: Congregations across the Empire could encourage pilgrims to travel to Bastion and contribute labour towards completing the Grand Inspiration of the Way.
t.Bregasland: Ottermire in Bregasland received Dripping Echoes of the Fen twice, one casting by the Circle of Zulgan-Tash.
t.Casinea: Casinea was enchanted with a magnitude 40 Night ritual, spreading dreams of the song Founders' Dance, especially among those walking or camping near the trods.
t.Hahnmark: Hahnmark's herb garden owners could work with the Zuredruiven vintners to grow two drams of Draaikolkbloem at the cost of other herbs.
t.Kallavesa: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh in Kallavesa.
t.Madruga: The Drakes remained lost in Crucible awaiting rescue, Freeborn fleets could hunt the Free Landing kraken, and the completed Calvos docks gave Freeborn fleets in Madruga an extra rank.
t.Mareave: Rivers of Life infused Mareave's waters with Spring power and reduced army casualties. Frozen Citadel was cast on Icarion, Clisearn and Nadir, Ramparts of Ashlar was cast on Rucraic's Redoubt, and units supporting the Seventh Wave there shared the Guerdon.
t.Mournwold: With Rebellion's Ridge consecrated to Pride, all personal resources in the Mournwold suffered a two-rank penalty, but its mine owners would elect the next senator.
t.Necropolis: Reumah's Rest in Coursmouth was strengthened with Ramparts of Ashlar by the Concordium of Pallas.
t.Ossium: Ossium's forests suffered a one-rank penalty from the Dubik but yielded blackblood thorns or bloodvine liquor, though Kurstrozi's Lumbermill was safe. A Thule coven's magnitude 80 Summer ritual made Summer encounters more common there.
t.Otkodov: Mentioned in passing: the Tsirku scouts hoped to learn of any connections between Tsirku and Otkodov.
t.Redoubt: The Walls of Cargo in Limus were strengthened with Ramparts of Ashlar by the Concordium of Pallas.
t.Reinos: The Suranni Black Eagle Banner under General Hendrick marched into Reinos as part of a larger effort to conquer it, inviting Imperial units to join. Sending purely magical troops would cause a diplomatic incident.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Military units supporting the Golden Axe in the Salt Flats of Sanath were among those sharing the Imperial Guerdon this season.
t.Sarangrave: Urizen could secure Kroll's lair for warding, the Coven of the Horned Hare cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Nesustak Forest, and the Tower of the Skink in Thornfen received Bells of Silver and Brass.
t.Sea of Snow: Mentioned in passing: the scouts suspected the western region of Tsirku might connect to the Sea of Snow, allowing sea beasts to reach the Grave of the Giants.
t.Segura: A magnitude 80 Night ritual infused the fountain of Anduz and aligned the old city's three great structures into the City of Wonders. The Firebrand, Hawker and Trailblazer archetypes would soon become available.
t.Semmerholm: Semmerholm was cursed with a magnitude 27 Autumn ritual embodying Things Go Awry, with effects obvious to all in the territory.
t.Sermersuaq: Mentioned in passing: Sermersuaq is not named, though the Mediator of Hyljehal secured the hylje's aid for the Tsirku scouts.
t.Skallahn: Mentioned in passing: the Tsirku scouts hoped to learn of any connections between Tsirku and Skallahn.
t.Spiral: Sustained attacks by Urizen, League and Dawnish units beat back the horrors of the Black Plateau and removed the Screed malignancy penalty, and the venture continued indefinitely. Hand of the Dhomiro also guided those fleeing or travelling past enemy patrols.
t.Temeschwar: With Virtue's Respite remade and the Pride of Temeschwar standing by a river gate, Temeschwari congregations could preach Pride in the city's honour for extra Synod votes.
t.Therunin: With the Golden Axe gone, Dochas Weeping Glade and Agramant's heralds offered Navarri a treasonous chance to retake Druj-held regions. Apothecaries could also work to cleanse the poison of the Lower Tarn Valley.
t.Tromsa: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Spymaster directed the Tsirku scouts westwards towards Tromsa and sought any connections to it.
t.Tsirku: Scouts were sent to explore Tsirku's western region with the hylje's help, needing 2,400 strength for any useful findings. The Whisper Gallery paid units to sabotage the effort.
t.Upwold: The Cabal Lyktan invoked the Hammers of Fury to speed mustering a new army in Upwold, cutting each mine's ingots by two in exchange for warm ashes.
t.Weirwater: A magnitude 80 Night ritual filled Weirwater with mysterious twilight music that stirs memories of love and friendship, making Night encounters and heralds of Sung and Janon more common.

r.Bregasland/Ottermire: Ottermire received Dripping Echoes of the Fen twice, including once from the Circle of Zulgan-Tash.
r.Kallavesa/West Marsh: West Marsh was enchanted with Dripping Echoes of the Fen by the Sussivari Frost Coven.
r.Madruga/Crucible: The Drakes remained lost in Crucible's transformative marshes. The strength of the rescue would decide whether they escaped by the Winter Solstice and how many soldiers they lost, from 2,000 strength down to none.
r.Madruga/Free Landing: Freeborn fleets could hunt Free Landing's juvenile kraken for money and ambrellic, with the Magpies earning extra treasure through the Wraith King's crew.
r.Mareave/Clisearn: Clisearn was protected with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Ashen Flame coven.
r.Mareave/Eoradal: Rucraic's Redoubt in Eoradal was strengthened with Ramparts of Ashlar by the Concordium of Pallas.
r.Mareave/Icarion: Icarion was protected with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Ashen Flame coven.
r.Mareave/Nadir: Nadir was protected with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Phoenix Rising coven.
r.Necropolis/Coursmouth: Reumah's Rest in Coursmouth received Ramparts of Ashlar from the Concordium of Pallas.
r.Otkodov/Sküld: Mentioned in passing: a ritual named Arc of Sküld was raised and funded for Imperial Lore by Yarvi Swiftwind for the Silver Chalice.
r.Redoubt/Limus: The Walls of Cargo in Limus received Ramparts of Ashlar from the Concordium of Pallas.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: Urizen units needed 7,500 strength to secure Kroll's lair so that seven rings of ilium could seal the creature until Urizen magicians called it to defend the region.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: Nesustak Forest was enchanted with Forge the Wooden Fastness by the Coven of the Horned Hare.
r.Sarangrave/Thornfen: The Tower of the Skink in Thornfen received Bells of Silver and Brass from the Concordium of Pallas.
r.Spiral/Screed: Three seasons of fighting removed the penalty that Screed's malignancy had imposed on military units.
r.Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley: Members of the Apothecaries' Guild with physick or apothecary skills could help cleanse the valley's poison, needing at least 30 to make headway. The Gardens of High Chalcis covered the cost this season.
